svg.title: Capital Health Region — Building Partnerships for Better Health — June 2000 dark and grey variant
svg.desc: Complete original vector artwork from Caring for your Onsite Sewage Disposal System, printed 06/2000, PDF page 1. Archived source: https://web.archive.org/web/20010706153320id_/http://www.caphealth.org:80/mho/HPES/pdf/disposal.pdf. Native emblem, outlined name and tagline, original fills, white separators and strokes retained. No tracing, font substitution or recolouring. White separator strokes and the white wordmark knockout belong to this white-background variant.
